locator_convention: Physical pages are one-based PDF page numbers; printed pages are the page footers. Annotation subjects locate groups; their text and rectangles must be read against the primary body.

items.source_location: Physical 563 / printed 548, Table 237 continuation; physical 585 / printed 570, Table 255; physical 593 / printed 578, Table 260.
items.annotation_evidence: The two replacement groups at physical 563 change the two SubFilter names in NOTE 3: the effective deprecated pair is adbe.x509.rsa_sha1 and adbe.pkcs7.sha1. They do not edit the AddRevInfo condition above. Physical 585 adds the same deprecation note; physical 593 adds a footnote c marker to the table.
items.effective_change: Correct the deprecation note, not the AddRevInfo signing condition. Existing legacy reading is not rendered forbidden by this correction.
items.implementation_and_assertions: Parent read signature::an_encapsulating_signature_is_checked_against_its_content_and_not_its_attribute (literal integrity answer plus malformed detached control), a_pkcs1_signature_names_the_key_rather_than_the_encoding, and a_pkcs1_signature_verifies_against_the_certificate_in_its_cert_entry (real certificate/signature verification and changed-message negative). These are distinct checks; the first alone is not cryptographic authenticity.
items.verdict: No reader defect established. Preserve legacy reading; do not convert PDF 2.0 signing deprecation into a prohibition on parsing or validating such signatures.
items.residuals: No signing producer is in scope for this tree. This is not a recertification of all Table 260 algorithms or all signature validation behavior.

items.annotation_evidence: Two StrikeOut annotations remove the word inheritable from the Flags and CharSet rows in Table 239. The row's corrected scope is action-local; the original table marks are visibly struck through in the primary PDF.
items.effective_change: Flags and CharSet are optional properties of the SubmitForm action dictionary and are not inherited. This corrects the table's scope label; it does not change the meaning of a value present on the action itself.
items.implementation_and_assertions: crates/pdf-model/src/action.rs::submit_form reads Flags and CharSet directly from the passed action dictionary. The unit test each_of_the_three_form_action_types_reaches_its_own_answer supplies action-local /Flags 5 and /CharSet (utf-8), then asserts both decoded values. No field-parent inheritance is consulted.
items.verdict: Implementation matches the corrected scope. Existing test proves action-local values are consumed; a distinct absent-action-key versus same-named enclosing-field control would add little because action dictionaries have no inheritance chain in this API. No draft warranted.
items.residuals: I did not find a reader path that looks up either property outside the SubmitForm action dictionary.

items.effective_clause: 12.7.8.3.1, FDF catalog General, paragraph above Table 247
items.annotation_evidence: StrikeOut/Caret replaces the opening of the paragraph at physical 576 with a qualification naming FDF file encryption specifically. Table 247 follows on physical 577; it is not a paragraph following that table.
items.classification: editorial clarification of a deprecated legacy mechanism
items.effective_change: Deprecation attaches to encryption, not all embedded FDF files. The current ledger already explicitly cites #173 and retains ordinary embedded FDF import while ignoring encrypted embedded FDF with a report.
items.implementation_and_assertions: Current implemented ledger row 12.7.8.3.1 cites ADRs 1185/1622. forms_data resolves EncryptionRevision and skips the encrypted stream with a named owed message. Parent read an_encrypted_embedded_fdf_is_refused_by_name: it asserts no imported embedded data and the exact report.
items.verdict: No new gap. The draft statement that no dedicated consumer claim was found was incomplete; current code and ledger explicitly implement the deprecated-encryption refusal policy.
items.residuals: The test proves named refusal, not encryption/decryption interoperability. No full FDF import certificate.

items.effective_change: The edit repairs the example pointer. The operative shall statements around the example still state which resources are copied and which marked-content range is replaced; no algorithmic requirement is added by the reference wording.

items.effective_clause: Table 208, Microsoft Windows launch parameter dictionary
items.annotation_evidence: StrikeOut/Caret replaces the misspelled type phrase ‘bye string’ with ‘byte string’ in the /D row (default directory). The surrounding table keeps /F and /P as byte strings and /O as an ASCII string.
items.effective_change: The value is a byte string, consistent with its neighboring path/parameter rows. This corrects descriptive type spelling; it does not define a launch-time runtime or an encoding conversion algorithm.
items.implementation_and_assertions: Current departed ledger row 12.6.4.6 reads the common F entry and does not interpret deprecated Win parameters. ADR 1358 was extended by 2171/2185 for non-PDF document handoff; programs remain refused. This issue changes only the D type-label typo, not that host policy.
items.verdict: No reader defect established from a type-label typo in a deprecated platform-specific action dictionary.
items.residuals: No Windows launch host integration was tested or claimed.

items.effective_clause: Table 238, certificate seed value dictionary, SignaturePolicyCommitmentType type cell
items.annotation_evidence: The StrikeOut rectangle covers only the capital A in Array in the type cell; the Caret inserts lowercase a. The current cell is Array of ASCII strings.
items.effective_change: Array becomes array; no data-shape or accepted-element change.
items.implementation_and_assertions: The current reader does not use signature seed-value dictionaries to validate existing signatures; the row constrains signature creation. Seed-value processing is outside this reader's behavior claims.
items.verdict: No behavior gap or new test warranted.
items.residuals: No full signature seed-value or signing-workflow certification.

review_boundary: This is a bounded review of the selected annotated corrections, not a full audit of signatures, forms, multimedia, collections, launch actions, or measurement properties. No candidate was treated as a defect solely because its issue number was absent from a ledger citation.
